newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia off, UPM up in Helsinki.
newsitem.headline: Nokia off, UPM up in Helsinki.

text.p: Shares in Nokia eased and in UPM-Kymmene rose in early Thursday dealings after the forestry group said it sold a large chunk of shares in the telecoms group to Goldman Sachs for international reoffering.
At 1030/0730 GMT, Nokia was marked down 8.00 markka or about two percent at 385.00 markka, with UPM gaining 2.00 markka or about one and half percent at 124.90.
Brokers said news of the Nokia sale would invite some profit-taking in Nokia, which has recently been very strong.
UPM was seen gaining partly because of the benefit to its balance sheet and also amid some speculation it may use the 1.5 billion markka capital gain on the deal to buy a competitor, brokers added.
UPM said it would use the cash to improve its balance sheet.
